4.3 Secondly, no meaningful information can be derived from two of the four available logbooks namely those individually kept by Wang Yan House (Block A) and Wang Tao House (Block B) why the FS pump rooms of those blocks were found unlocked during inspection on the day of the fire. 3 By illustration:-
4.3.1 Wang Yan House (Block A): As stated in paragraph 10.4 of my 1st Witness Statement, the FS pump room there was found unlocked during the inspection on 26.11.2025. However, as shown in the logbook kept at the same block, the key to the FS pump room was last borrowed on 24.11.2025 and had been returned for safekeeping at 13:18 on the same day. Presumably, the FS pump room should have been locked on the day of the fire, but the reason why it was found unlocked cannot be deduced from the relevant logbook.
